nameOrigin: hexagonal structure storing honey in a beehive

pokedexEntries.di: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

pokedexEntries.prl: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

pokedexEntries.pt: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

pokedexEntries.hgss: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

pokedexEntries.bw: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.

pokedexEntries.x: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

pokedexEntries.or: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

pokedexEntries.y: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

pokedexEntries.as: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

pokedexEntries.sw: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

pokedexEntries.sh: It ceaselessly gathers nectar from sunrise to sundown, all for the sake of Vespiquen and the swarm.

pokedexEntries.bd: Three Pokémon joined to become one. It busily carries sweet nectar to Vespiquen.

pokedexEntries.shp: They collect and deliver honey to their colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

pokedexEntries.la: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.
